english.title: Promote a race / speed trial between motor vehicles on a public way
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) promoted

(A)_[a race]_
(B)_[trial of speed]_

between motor vehicles on a public way, namely **(..SPECIFY PUBLIC WAY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Timekeepers , stewards, promoters and possibly passengers may be convicted of this offence.
(ii) See H3045 for the offence wording relating to unauthorised races or competitions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) In the statement of facts specify whether the defendant took part as a driver, passenger, timekeeper or steward or give details of the nature of the promotion and give details of speeds reached and any danger caused to other road users.
(v) See also offence wording: H3044.
